text:
mira: Heads up — saw ~1.2% of inbound leads stuck as unassigned after the enrichment step (last 6h). :eyes:
sam: Ugh, saw that too. Do we have a common cause? enrichment TTL or the owner mapping? :thinking:
mira: Timeline: HS enrichment webhook returns OK but owner_id is null for some rows. It prevents rotation from kicking in.
alex: Paging sales-ops — @jamie can you check HubSpot owner sync? I suspect the new property name we rolled out yesterday.
jamie: On it. I see a mapping drift for property "preferred_owner_v2" → our SF owner field. Some leads end up without owner fallback.
sales-ops-bot: automated note: last HS -> SF sync completed at 2025-11-12T09:12:03Z, 3 warnings (owner mapping mismatch)
sam: Quick mitigation: can we change router timeout to trigger fallback pool at 45s instead of 90s? That'll reduce visible unassigned leads.
mira: Agree. Also propose a backstop rule: if enrichment returns owner=null after 30s, mark for overflow pool and send heartbeat ticket to routing team.
alex: I can ship a config tweak: router.timeout.enrichment = 45s, router.backstop.on_null_owner = "overflow-pool". Minimal risk.
jamie: After we flip that, I will patch HS workflow to populate legacy_owner if preferred_owner_v2 missing. Rolling now.
router-bot: config change queued: router.timeout.enrichment -> 45s (will rollout 1% -> 10% -> 100%)
sam: Great. Post-deploy checks: can someone run a small sample of 5k leads through the pipeline and confirm no owner leakage?
mira: I'll run the smoke test and share a quick CSV of failures.
jamie: FYI, I also set an alert: GA -> slack if unassigned rate > 0.5% for 15m.
alex: Notes for postmortem: need better owner-schema compatibility tests in integration suite and an automated migration for legacy properties.
mira: Thanks all. I'll follow up with a short runbook for the 45s backstop and the HS property rename.
sam: :thumbsup: Closing in 30m if no regressions.
